title: BACK IN MEDIEVAL TIMES WITH RODRIGO
text:
Rodrigo was one of the two best guides we have had the opportunity to work with.  He completely rearranged our tour to allow us to see what we wanted to see rather than what was proposed.  He was positive, helpful, knowledgeable and worldly experienced.  We spent 9 hours with Rodrigo and enjoyed every minute.  

We added Besalu to the tour and it was our favorite stop as a truly medieval town.  Montserrat was not to be missed. Gerona was a plus but we hit Vic in the afternoon shutdown.  It could not be helped as we were on a very fast track.
Besalu with its bridge, gate and medieval buildings
author: Larry W

title: Excellent tour
text: Knowledgeable and very courteous guide. Had a great time during the tour and we saw everything we wanted to see.  The guide went the extra mile and recommended a great restaurant to have dinner in Barcelona after our return.
